Class SsDataGridAdapter

java.lang.Object
dev.visdb.seesaw.table.SsDataGridAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
SsDataGridHandler
public abstract class SsDataGridAdapter extends Object implements SsDataGridHandler
This abstract class is provided as a convenience for creating custom SsDataGridHandler objects. Extend this class to create a SsDataGridHandler implementation.

SsDataGridHandlerImpl defines empty functions so that the programmer can define only the functions desired.
